query.description: Filter by a range or CSV of category IDs.
Parent category ID.
Parent category URL code.
Only list categories followed by the current user.
List the categories followed by the given UserID
The maximum tree depth to return when getting a tree structure. This parameter is incompatible with a flat structure.
Filter by archived status of a category. True for archived only. False for no archived categories.
Only list featured categories.
Page number. See [Pagination](https://docs.vanillaforums.com/apiv2/#pagination). This parameter is incompatible with a tree structure.
Desired number of items per page. This parameter is incompatible with a tree structure.
Sort the results.
Expand associated records using one or more valid field names. A value of "all" will expand all expandable fields.
Expand associated records using one or more valid field names. A value of "all" will expand all expandable fields.

Filter categories by site section ID (ex. subcommunity).
The subcommunity ID or folder can be used if you use [smart IDs](https://success.vanillaforums.com/kb/articles/46-smart-ids).
The query looks like:

```
siteSectionID=$subcommunityID:{id|folder}
```
example: "$subcommunityID:en".
Whether to include the parent category when used with parentCategoryID, parentCategoryCode, or siteSectionID.
Format of the output as flat or tree.
Layout View Type.
Filter by allowed post type ID
Allowed status for the post type ID filter.
Filter out categories that cannot be posted into
Only return fields with these keys from the output. Use dot notation for nested fields.
Only return fields with these keys from the output. Use dot notation for nested fields.
